terra.problem: David opens by expressing love, not by giving the thank-you the explanation attributes to him.
The psalm says the torrents overwhelmed David, not that they were over his head.
Saying David's cry reached the LORD's ears from the temple makes the temple sound like the cry's origin. The LORD hears from His temple.
Hail is water, so describing the hailstones as 'not water' is inaccurate.
The nap joke makes an imagined action of the LORD the punchline.
The bragging line makes an imagined action of the LORD part of the joke.
The cold cookie sheet comparison doesn't clearly show forgetting. It needs context to make the connection.
The verse doesn't say David's ankles give out on a narrower path. It says the LORD broadens his path so they do not give way.
Identifying Joab as a commander asserts a Bible fact outside this passage without a reference.
The psalm says David had not known the people, not that he had never met them. Saul's search for David is also a fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The verse says the people will serve David; it doesn't say they never attack him.
The cookie cutter joke plays off people cowering before David, making light of their fearful situation.
Being exalted above his foes doesn't establish that David is now out of their reach.
